description: WCH CH224K — USB PD 3.0 sink controller, negotiates 5V/9V/12V/15V/20V from USB-C PD source. ESSOP-10 package. Single-resistor voltage selection. Ideal for replacing barrel jacks.
name: ch224k
watch_out_for: Only negotiates 5V/9V/12V/20V PD profiles — does NOT support PPS. Requires USB-C PD source; won't work with USB-A-to-C cable on a dumb 5V port. 10µF output cap minimum.
